cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Four hundred and twenty quid. Fourteenth of March, 2019. I know because I wrote it in the book, because that's what you do."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "He's had six years and about nine conversations to say 'here's your money' and instead I get — " he does an impression that is unkind and quite accurate — " 'we're all right, aren't we.'"
It is four hundred and twenty pounds. Archie has, in the time you've known him, given away a vein.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Also, he's Crystal Palace. Obviously untrustworthy." He says it in the specific tone of a man producing a joke because the real answer has run out.
So that's what that is. A tenner's worth of grievance with six years of compound interest on it. You stop wondering about it, which is exactly what you were supposed to do.
